name: doc-preview
description: Previews the documents Claude writes in docview: the band above the prompt offers the Markdown, diagram, data or HTML file a turn changed, opens it in the browser at the edited line, and the open tab follows later edits by itself; /docview lists them

command.title: docview command
command.description: The command that starts docview, split on spaces; docview by default (npm install -g github:simota/docview)

allowNpx.title: Fall back to npx
allowNpx.description: When the command is not found, run npx -y github:simota/docview, which runs docview's main branch unpinned; off by default

basePort.title: First port
basePort.description: The first port tried; the next 19 follow. 4000, docview's default, is never used, as a docview started there shuts down the one already running

autoOpen.title: Open on its own
autoOpen.description: first opens the browser when a turn ends, on the latest document written that was never opened; off waits for a press
